title: High-throughput screening of high-activity oxygen carriers for chemical looping argon purification via a machine learning – density functional theory method
content:

DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01575D, Paper

A new method based on machine learning and DFT calculations for screening oxygen carriers during chemical looping argon purification is proposed in this study.
